ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ar1: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ
ar2: فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
en1: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea,"
en2: and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
en61: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
en62: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
